about: Hand-written exemplar slides for the builder agent. Select 2-3 by technique (match the storyboard's explainer type), never by topic. Paths are relative to packages/forge. Technique ids are defined in fixtures/exemplars/TECHNIQUES.md.

decks.theme: dark cinematic violet; IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono; cyan / violet / amber accents; radial-glow backdrop
light technical; warm off-white #f6f4ef, ink boxes; Inter Tight + Work Sans + JetBrains Mono; teal / blue / vermilion
editorial paper; Fraunces display + Source Serif 4 body + Plex Mono; oxblood / deep teal / ochre; vignette backdrop
bold data story; near-black #0b0b0c, flat; Space Grotesk + Inter + JetBrains Mono; electric lime highlight, orange-red callouts
calm science night; deep teal #0e1c21 with soft glow; Source Serif 4 headings + Inter + Plex Mono; aqua / soft gold / coral

slides.title: Engineering Silence
slides.whatMakesItGood: Light-weight display type with one gradient accent word against a large procedural 3D object (lathe + capsule primitives, env lighting, rim light, floating contact shadow). Copy left, object right, three-beat agenda strip. Idle float/sway keeps it alive without distracting.

slides.title: Eight parts, one job
slides.whatMakesItGood: Assembled -> exploded with a GSAP-tweened explode factor and camera dolly. Eight named procedural parts (incl. a canvas-textured PCB). HTML .df-tag labels track projected 3D anchors every frame via kit.toSlide; leader lines are SVG. Labels are introduced a few per step, alternating above/below so nothing collides. One caption line per step.

slides.title: Following the signal
slides.whatMakesItGood: Four colour-coded flows sampled from SVG paths into lookup tables, drawn as moving beads on a 2D canvas. One flow is added per step with its legend key lighting up, so the system is built up pass by pass. Node glyphs are tiny inline SVG paths in glass rings.

slides.title: Timing is everything
slides.whatMakesItGood: Three stacked canvas lanes (input, correction, sum) driven by a real formula. Slider + segmented toggle update a live dB stat, a meter and a plain-language verdict instantly. Waves scroll in onFrame; the maths lives in one small function.

slides.title: Key takeaways
slides.whatMakesItGood: Four equal cards with mono numbers, one-line titles, short bodies and a footer fact; staggered GSAP timeline reveal. A generative SVG wave that flattens left-to-right echoes the topic without clip art.

slides.title: One connection, many conversations
slides.whatMakesItGood: Frames flow through a single pipe between two ink-bordered boxes; the toggle switches the frame order (HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2) and the receiving panel's progress bars and two big stats change accordingly. The sim is a pure function of time, so shot mode freezes a representative moment (api.shot). Steps and toggle share one setMode().

slides.title: Five instructions in flight
slides.whatMakesItGood: Clickable step tabs (call api.setStep so keyboard and tabs stay in sync) drive a cycle-by-instruction grid plus a live 'what is in each stage' panel. A hazard step shows a hatched bubble moving down the pipe. Each step = one idea, one caption.

slides.title: How a message floods a mesh
slides.whatMakesItGood: Deterministic seeded layout + nearest-neighbour edges, BFS hop distances computed in the slide. Each step lights the next hop's nodes and edges in its own colour, pulses travel along the frontier edges, a ripple marks the source, and a side legend counts nodes per hop.

slides.title: Seven clocks that changed timekeeping
slides.whatMakesItGood: Piecewise (broken) time scale with an explicit break mark, tinted era bands with italic serif labels, and event cards on two alternating levels with leader lines. Events arrive era by era; small accuracy chips carry the real argument. Paper backdrop and serif pairing give the editorial tone.

slides.title: Time is money
slides.whatMakesItGood: One sentence at 150px italic serif. Words are split into masked spans that rise in sequence, the key word is coloured and gets a hand-drawn SVG underline (stroke-dashoffset). Attribution with a rule; a context column arrives on the second step. Huge ornamental quote mark in a muted accent.

slides.title: Fixing onboarding halved churn
slides.whatMakesItGood: SVG bar chart built in four beats: baseline + bracket note, launch marker, post-launch bars in the highlight colour, then a drawn trend curve and a counter falling to the headline number. The headline states the conclusion; data is labelled fictional; muted colour for context, one bright colour for the story.

slides.title: Before and after
slides.whatMakesItGood: A three-row metric table: label column, muted 'before' numbers, bold 'after' numbers that count up (GSAP tween on a plain object + onUpdate) with pill-shaped delta chips popping in. The after column is held back until step 2.

slides.title: How fast does an outbreak burn?
slides.whatMakesItGood: A real SIR model integrated in the slide; two sliders (R0, vaccinated share) redraw S/I/R curves, three live stats and a verdict sentence that teaches the threshold 1 - 1/R0. A dashed guide line marks where the peak happens. The equations are shown as a footnote.

slides.title: Jupiter's clockwork moons
slides.whatMakesItGood: A non-gadget 3D scene: canvas-painted banded planet, moons on line orbits with real periods, deterministic starfield, single sun light. Labels follow the moons via kit.toSlide and are clamped on-screen. A side panel counts completed orbits live, making the 4:2:1 resonance visible on step 2.

slides.title: Two allele shares fix all three genotype shares
slides.whatMakesItGood: Each term of p² + 2pq + q² = 1 owns one colour across an equation span, an area of a Punnett square whose sides are split p | q (so area = share) and a plain-words row. One term per step, unrevealed terms ghosted; the last step tweens p to a real value and the sliver cells get leader-line tags.

slides.title: One shared line halves the worst wait
slides.whatMakesItGood: Chip positions are a pure function of (mode, shopper, t) on a deterministic schedule; chips are coloured by how long they waited and a per-item wait-bar strip shows the spread, so the two modes differ in colour and bar height, not only in the big stats. Toggle and steps share one setMode via api.setStep.

slides.title: With air drag, the longest kick is flatter than 45°
slides.whatMakesItGood: A fixed-dt integrator fills an equal-scale metres plot: a faint fan of runs every 5°, the live run bold, the best angle dashed, a vacuum ghost with a 'drag costs N m' bracket, and apex/landing chips on leaders. A right column holds the toggle, two sliders, four readouts with units, a verdict and the equation footnote.

slides.title: Sunlight runs out in the first 200 metres
slides.whatMakesItGood: Five equal bands on a declared piecewise depth axis, names left and light/temperature/pressure columns right. One layout() derives every band, tick and row from tweened heights; each step expands one band with an accent outline, dims the rest and tags that zone's drawn creature on a leader.

slides.title: Protect seven hours, in step with your body clock
slides.whatMakesItGood: Four equal cards with a colour-keyed top rule, mono number, one-line title, bodies of similar length and a sourced footer fact. Under them a generated one-night hypnogram draws in, REM in the accent and one '≈ 90 min' cycle bracketed to tie back to a card; one closing line.

slides.title: Every note is a chord in disguise
slides.whatMakesItGood: Weight-200 display headline with one gradient word, a one-line lede and a three-beat agenda strip on the left; on the right a generative SVG string: the summed vibration in the accent on top, its first five modes stacked below with nodes marked and mono labels. Gentle onFrame sway, fixed t in shot mode.

slides.title: Two loops, one pump
slides.whatMakesItGood: Four flows are SVG paths sampled once into lookup tables and drawn as glowing beads on a full-slide canvas, colour-coded by meaning. One flow per step lights its legend key and outlines the chambers it passes; numbered tags sit outside the boxes on leaders so beads never cross text; one big real-number chip.

slides.title: Animals fill only the last eighth of Earth's history
slides.whatMakesItGood: A piecewise scale squeezes the first 3.8 billion years and stretches the last 700 million, with a visible ≈ break. Tinted eon bands brighten as they are reached, event cards hang above and below the axis on leader lines, and two day-clock chips computed in the slide carry the argument.

slides.title: Traffic jams with no cause
slides.whatMakesItGood: A seeded cellular automaton is simulated whole on every change (warm-up, then 160 rows), so a full space–time diagram coloured by speed fills the canvas in shot mode. Slider and toggle drive speed, flow and stopped-share readouts with units and a verdict; the annotation measures a real jam's backward speed rather than placing a guess.

slides.title: Remove the otter, lose the forest
slides.whatMakesItGood: A 19-node web laid out by trophic row from an edge list; node size from computed degree and the cascade set derived in code. Steps light one node's links, remove it, grow the next group with pulses on its edges, then fade the dependants while a stat counts them; legend with group counts.

slides.title: Your hand is written in letters two nanometres wide
slides.whatMakesItGood: Five nested SVG levels, each grown from the parent's dashed aim box by an outer wrapper (origin at the parent's aim) and an inner SVG (origin at its own aim) with expo.inOut. A size ladder, a scale bar and a magnification counter tweened in log space show the magnitude; each level keeps one labelled reference object.

slides.title: Sunlight kept must equal heat shed
slides.whatMakesItGood: Each term of S(1 − α)/4 = σT⁴ is a coloured span that rises per step while the same colour lights its part of an SVG diagram (beam, reflected rays, disc vs sphere, infrared). A side card names the term in plain words and carries the running value down to a real result and the gap it explains.

slides.title: The deaths gathered around one pump
slides.whatMakesItGood: A stylised hand-drawn street plan with a few named streets and point markers; data drawn as bars stacked outward from the streets by a seeded generator. A walking-distance catchment is computed in the slide and outlined, a live stat counts what falls inside, and the footnote says what is stylised.

slides.title: Seven parts, no pump: capillaries move the ink
slides.whatMakesItGood: A non-electronic object from lathe, cone and cylinder primitives with physical materials, lit for a light paper ground with a contact shadow. One explode.k tween drives the parts and a camera dolly, small parts turn their faces to the camera as they fly out, and labels track toSlide anchors alternating above and below.

slides.title: A Bill becomes law only when both Houses agree
slides.whatMakesItGood: Tabs call api.setStep and render(i) derives everything from one step table: a two-lane stage grid with done / current / future states, a hatched warm-accent exception with a drawn zig-zag, a final seal, and a current-state row plus a caption.

slides.title: A starter is a loop you keep feeding
slides.whatMakesItGood: Four stages on a circle with arrowed arcs, the purpose in the centre and labels outside the nodes. A glowing token rides only the active arc (fixed phase in shot mode) so it never covers a label, and a drawn jar is the evidence: its level rises and falls with the stage, with a legend and live stats.

slides.title: Nearly half of the world's languages are endangered
slides.whatMakesItGood: One 128px sentence in masked word spans that rise in sequence, the key word in the highlight with an SVG underline placed from offsetLeft/offsetTop, attribution on a rule. A faint giant fraction sits behind a 10×10 dot field; step 2 fills the dots so the number becomes a picture.

slides.title: A trillion seconds is 31,700 years
slides.whatMakesItGood: One log-space camera value drives every nested frame (scale = 10^(window − camera) about one shared focus), so each step zooms out ×1000 with expo.inOut and the previous frame collapses into a labelled sliver. A familiar reference per level, a counting readout and a power-of-ten ladder show the magnitude.

slides.title: Same warm house, a third of the energy
slides.whatMakesItGood: Three aligned rows: label, muted A column, bold B column, each number paired with a proportional bar. B is held back until step 2, then counts up while its bars grow and delta chips pop with back.out; units a third the size of the numbers, assumptions in a mono footnote.

slides.title: Five layers spread every wheel's weight
slides.whatMakesItGood: Five RoundedBox slabs with seeded CanvasTexture speckle. Each step lifts the layers above the active one, outlines it in the accent and dims the rest by tinting (not transparency). Left-column tags follow each slab via kit.toSlide with a min-gap sweep; a detail card on the right swaps per layer.

slides.title: Most Australians live on a thin coastal rim
slides.whatMakesItGood: A recognisable coastline from ~110 lon/lat points through a one-line projection; the same path serves as fill, clipPath, outline and a clipped coastal band. Steps add a hatched zone, population-sized circles with sea-side leader tags, then the band and one huge stat; legend keys light per step, projection in the footnote.

slides.title: Learning fast means going round faster
slides.whatMakesItGood: Three stage nodes and three artefact chips on one circle, arcs trimmed clear of what they join, arrowheads only into stages. A glowing token laps the ring behind the nodes (parked on bare arc in shot mode); each step fills the active node, lights its outgoing leg and swaps a side panel.
